trigger: Previous capture trace has a main-thread sendto still blocked at detach; saved-frame intervals reach 28/30s under regression load.

implementation.scope: Capture local6 and web local7 handlers; stderr selection stays unchanged.
implementation.preserved: Facility, severity, formatter output, originating process/thread metadata, UTF-8 and null-terminated Unix syslog wire messages.
implementation.bounds: 2048 pending byte payloads per handler; 16384-byte message cap with explicit truncation marker. Warning/error/critical can evict lower-severity queued records. Saturation counts are emitted on recovery, including warning-or-higher losses.
implementation.transport: Per-process daemon sender, 0.2s socket timeout and retry, Unix datagram with stream fallback; fork closes only inherited socket copy and creates independent sender/locks. Shutdown drain is bounded.
implementation.manifest: Regression now hashes allsky.py, which selects the capture handler. Runner fixture includes and verifies mutation detection for that entrypoint.

tests.native_socket: macOS real Unix receiver saturation: 200 messages enqueued without waiting for receiver, later all 200 received in order; byte-for-byte standard SysLogHandler parity.
tests.additional: Missing destination recovery; frozen mutable args; UTF-8 truncation; priority overflow and loss notice; fork with parent logging/initialization locks held and stalled sender; parent socket preservation; bounded shutdown.
tests.initial_failures: Sandbox blocked Unix socket bind; test rerun with approved local socket access. Native macOS message-size limit exposed permanent oversize retry; corrected via explicit progressively shorter transport payload.
tests.earlier_run: First regression intentionally interrupted to update runner self-test fixture for the newly hashed allsky.py; not claimed passed.

limits: Logging isolation is verified, but cadence remains open: saved-frame maxima 19/25 seconds and monotonic command warnings 22.540/25.039 seconds under load.
Bounded logs are best effort under prolonged outage/saturation or shutdown. No logging queue can guarantee retaining unlimited messages without blocking capture.
Asynchronous delivery means syslog receiver timestamps can lag message creation; saved-frame times and caller-computed cadence warnings are needed for cadence acceptance.

residual_trace.unresolved_at_detach: Both main threads were in clock_nanosleep; no completion duration claimed.
residual_trace.limit: This trace occurred after the observed long intervals and does not identify their cause.
